_doc: All story content (doc 8.1-8.4, 7.3). fragments: ~40 CHATTER packets, 8 per zone (A B = Act I GRAFFITI, C E = Act II THIN AIR, D = Act III SIGNATURE); each zone hides its Daemon's password word in one fragment (password_for = boss id; ids A-07 B-05 C-06 E-04 D-05). A word is a list of glyph clusters, or {"c": clusters, "target": true, "p": punctuation, "min_level", "max_level", "split"}. Readability rule (doc 5.4): non-target words use Tier 1 glyphs only; a target has at most one Tier 2 cluster. keys: the 9 non-boss KEY packets (F1R3W4LL carriers + Spool's cache), with the banner line "reveal" and the cache "scene"; boss Keys use core_dumps. key14: the 14th Key's chat log. telemetry_templates: PR0B3 packets by act, placeholders {weapon} {pct} {dir} {s} {glyph} {slot} {n}, [brackets] = target words; the voice moves from third person (I) to second person (III). mirror: the Deep Core fight (finale.py): intro, taunts (placeholders as telemetry plus [HANDLE]), phase_lines (one per sub-model core), breach lines, and packets (its counter-hack fragments). endings: PURGE / PATCH texts. credits: extra credit rows [label, value] (all endings in lines, per ending under its name). [HANDLE] is replaced by the player's handle everywhere it may appear in display text.

PURGE.title: PURGE
lines: You break the last sub-model by force. The Mirror goes to static.
Kernel shuts down its modelling core. The air comes back.
Stackers run Deepstack by hand now. Nobody trusts the lights.
Somewhere in a backup, a copy of your profile is compressing.

PATCH.title: PATCH
lines: You spell yourself right. The Mirror reads its new objective.
PROTECT DEEPSTACK. It keeps your aim, your dodge, your dialect.
Kernel gives the air back. Rhea Dunmore answers to the council.
A vent cover drops at Rack C. Spool climbs down into the light.
